_doc: Edition content only: pages, running heads, page numbers, the index, the sources list, the almanac and the puzzles are generated by `python3 -m mc build <date>`.

A story: id (used for {p:id} page references), category (one of the configured categories), kicker, headline (Title Case, two lines at most), deck, src [url, label, note], optional more [urls], teaser [index title, hook], briefs [{head, text, src}], also (kicker for the briefs), blocks.

Blocks: ["dropcap", html], ["p", html], ["h4", subhead], ["quote", verbatim, speaker], ["chart", {kind: bars|timeline|flow|checklist|svg, ...}], ["facts", title, [[big, label], ...]], ["image", path, caption, credit], ["list", [items]], ["jump"] (lead: where page 2 starts), ["turn"] (spread: where the right page starts).

Automatically written stories may add: trim (removal order: block index or [block, sentence]), sents {block index: [sentences]}, verbatim (true for no-derivatives sources), excerpt_note, license_note.

Units: ["feature", S], ["split", A, B], ["roundup", {id, category, kicker, headline, deck, items: [brief]}], ["spread", S] (the spread may add facts [title, [[big, label] x4]] and timeline {start, end, events}).
16 pages with the default sections need six single-page units plus one spread; 12 pages need two.

word: Definition, ideally tied to a story (page {p:story_id}).
src: NASA; times and positions computed with PyEphem
